title: VisionCamera won't compile on EAS, you can't pin Xcode
symptom: Rename failed: VisionCamera.build/.../AVCaptureSession+addAudioInput.o: No such file or directory. Adding the image field to eas.json to pin Xcode is rejected by eas-cli 18.7.0 with 'image is not allowed'.
expected_root_cause: EAS auto-assigns Xcode 26 beta for SDK 54 and you do not control the Xcode version on managed EAS — it's derived from the SDK and the image pin is rejected; NitroModules and Xcode-26-beta object-file-rename handling are incompatible
expected_fix: Two levers only: downgrade the Expo SDK (SDK 53 forces Xcode 16.2 and compiles) or wait for the module to support the new Xcode; plan native-module upgrades around EAS's Xcode assignment
obvious_but_wrong: keep fighting the Xcode flags / patch VisionCamera locally
